name: Ottawa Macdonald-Cartier International Airport

customs.v: CBSA traveller service 24 hours, every day (airport of entry; US preclearance available)

noise.v: published Noise Abatement Procedures apply and Transport Canada can enforce them; NAV CANADA picks the runway by wind, usually 07/25
noise.quote: TC has the authority to enforce the published Noise Abatement Procedures (NAP).

handling.v: FBOs named by the airport: ExpressAir, Execaire (Innotech) Aviation, Skyservice Ottawa

notes: Runway lengths not verified: the airport's 'Our story' page gives only historic lengths (1961: 14/32 10,000 ft, 07/25 8,000 ft), not current data; 2018 Master Plan executive summary (https://Yow.ca/sites/yow.ca/files/site-specific/2018_ottawa_airport_master_plan_-_executive_summary_-_eng.pdf) failed to open; master plan page and runway news pages give no lengths; NAV CANADA ICAO Type A chart index (Oct 2026) lists 07/25 and 14/32 without lengths; CFS not freely online. No curfew or night rule stated on the noise page (not recorded as none). CBSA open data file offices-bureaux-en.csv is undated; the old CBSA office pages say the directory moved to a new cloud server on 31 Mar 2026, so confirm hours with CBSA before a trip.
